test_title: PYST 06: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 05 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, G, H, I, J, K, L and M, are sitting in a row, facing north(but not necessarily in the same order) . Only G sits to the left of J. Only four people sit between G and H.

Only K sits between L and I, and L is not an immediate neighbour of H.

How many people sit between M and J?
solution:
Given, Seven people, G, H, I, J, K, L and M, are sitting in a row, facing north(but not necessarily in the same order) .

Only G sits to the left of J.

Only four people sit between G and H.
